user.title: Connect to Consumables
user.description: Open Consumables in your browser, go to Voice, and select Connect Home Assistant to generate a pairing code.

data_description.pairing_code: The 8-character code shown on the Voice page. It expires after 10 minutes.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code is invalid or has expired. Generate a new one and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that address. Check it and that this machine can see the server.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This household is already connected. Its token has been refreshed.
